'''WicketBasketCase Ewok Screen''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[WicketBasketCase]]
* '''Published:''' 16 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rebel Strike Team
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed RST WicketBasketCase LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Kind of reminiscent of the movie, having ewoks fly everywhere causing trouble while my mains do their RST work.

== Strategy ==

During the DS player's turn, I grab Madine and Han, if not already in my hand, then as follows

if DS is playing Endor:
Drop Han and Madine, grab Chewie, pull Wuta and Lumat out for free, get my defenses up. Then, use ewoks and scouts together to fight off whatever my opponent throws at me. The Epic Event is a bonus task, if I get the opportunity to complete it.

non-Endor Decks:
Drop Madine, maybe Han, get Beezer and Portable Scanner. Begin grabbing things for Deactivate the Shield Generator, and use ewoks in case of a wild beatdown. Jar Jar, Luke, Obi, Han, and Chewie are my characters for non-Endor battling, usually suicide runs. (I'm looking to fit an Nabrun in here for transporting characters on and off of Endor, any help there would be good)

Space decks:
Hunker down on Endor and plan for a drain race. Most likely I won't win, but I'll use battle plan DefShld to slow their drains and hopefully I'll Deactivate The Shield Generator to limit my differential loss.
